B.Pharm Sem I, BP101T Basics of Python Programming for Pharmaceutical Sciences, explained simply in English.

In this episode: Strings: joining, repeating, measuring, Slicing: a piece of a string and String methods: cleaning text. Then two common errors (IndexError / TypeError), a quick check and a recap.
